2011, c.226
Surveys Act
Definitions
1In this Act, “survey” means a survey to define boundaries.
2Service New Brunswick shall maintain a coordinate survey system.
Director of Surveys
3(1)Service New Brunswick shall designate a surveyor.
3(1.1)Service New Brunswick may designate one or more surveyors.
3(1.2)Only an eligible surveyor may be designated.
3(2)The Director shall establish coordinate monuments.
Regulations
15The Lieutenant-Governor in Council may make regulations.
SCHEDULE A The New Brunswick Plane Rectangular Coordinate Projection is a stereographic double projection. N.B. This Act is consolidated to October 1, 2015.
